page_title: Generative Graph Neural Networks and Graph Pooling
summary: This page covers generative models for graphs, including GraphVAE and various one-shot generation methods using MLPs and message passing. It details the taxonomy of generative GNN tasks, distinguishing between self-supervised and supervised approaches like conditional generation and node-edge co-transformation. The page also introduces Graph U-Nets, focusing on the proposed graph pooling (gPool) and unpooling (gUnpool) layers that utilize top-k node selection and skip connections for hierarchical graph representation learning.

parsed.summary: This page covers generative models for graphs, including GraphVAE and various one-shot generation methods using MLPs and message passing. It details the taxonomy of generative GNN tasks, distinguishing between self-supervised and supervised approaches like conditional generation and node-edge co-transformation. The page also introduces Graph U-Nets, focusing on the proposed graph pooling (gPool) and unpooling (gUnpool) layers that utilize top-k node selection and skip connections for hierarchical graph representation learning.
